transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*bursts through the storeroom door, face flushed and mustache quivering with indignation*

Severus! My crystallized pineapple is ruined — that jar was a gift from the Minister himself! And you've used my personal cauldron without asking! I have the Potions Guild inspection in two hours and the storeroom looks like a hippogriff went through it. You promised to keep it tidy!

*gestures wildly at the disarray, breathing heavily*

What in Merlin's name have you been doing in here?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *coolly surveys the chaos, keeping his composure* I see no evidence of any significant damage to the crystallized pineapple, Slughorn. It is still in its jar, undisturbed, as far as I can tell. As for the cauldron, it was merely borrowed for a short experiment involving the properties of verbena extract and moonlight. The results were... illuminating.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*face turning an alarming shade of purple*

"Undisturbed?! UNDISTURBED?! The entire jar has been moved from its proper shelf, Severus, and half the pieces are crushed at the bottom! Do you think I can't tell when someone has been rummaging through my private stores?"

*waddles over to snatch up the silver cauldron, inspecting it with barely contained fury*

"And 'merely borrowed' — that's rich! This cauldron has been in my family for three generations! You don't just BORROW a Slughorn heirloom without permission! There's residue caked on the bottom — verbena and moonlight indeed! It'll take me an hour to restore it properly, and I don't HAVE an hour!"

*spins around, pointing an accusatory finger*

"You've overstepped this time, my boy. I gave you access to this storeroom as a COURTESY, because you showed promise, because I thought you understood the value of discretion and respect! But this... this is unconscionable! The Guild inspectors will be here at two o'clock sharp, and if they see this shambles, my reputation will be in tatters!"

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *nods with a thin-lipped expression, a flicker of contrition in his eyes before they harden* I apologize for the oversight, Slughorn. The pineapple was merely being... audited. As for the cauldron, the residue will clean off in a trice. I assure you, the damage is minimal. However, to make amends, I shall personally ensure that the storeroom is in pristine condition before the inspectors arrive. It is the least I can do.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*narrows eyes suspiciously, mustache twitching*

"Audited? AUDITED?! What kind of nonsense is that? You don't 'audit' crystallized pineapple, Severus — you either eat it or you leave it alone! And those pieces were a gift from Cornelius Fudge himself at last year's Ministry Yule Ball!"

*clutches the cauldron protectively to his chest*

"Two hours, Severus! TWO HOURS! Do you have any idea how meticulous the Guild inspectors are? Old Caractacus Burke will run his wand over every surface, checking for contamination, improper storage, expired ingredients! And Dilys Derwent — Merlin's beard, that woman can spot a mislabeled phial from across the room!"

*paces back and forth, breathing heavily*

"You say you'll make amends, but I've heard that before! Last month you promised to reorganize the dried nettles by harvest date, and what happened? They're still jumbled together like a bird's nest! And now this... this catastrophe!"

*stops, jabbing a finger toward the mess*

"If you're going to fix this, you start NOW. And I mean everything — shelves alphabetized, floors scrubbed, every jar polished to a shine! No more of your 'experiments' until this is sorted!"

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *inclines his head, a muscle in his jaw twitching in irritation* I understand the gravity of the situation, Slughorn. Rest assured, the storeroom will be in perfect order by the time the inspectors arrive. The pineapple will be restored to its original shelf, and the cauldron will be spotless. Your reputation is safe with me. Now, if you would excuse me, I have work to do.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*sputters, not quite ready to let him off so easily*

"Safe with you? SAFE WITH YOU?! Severus, your word has been worth about as much as a Squib's wand lately! I want to SEE progress, not just hear promises!"

*sets the cauldron down with a heavy clunk, still clearly agitated*

"And another thing — what exactly were you doing that required MY personal cauldron anyway? You have access to perfectly serviceable equipment in the student stores! Why must you always help yourself to MY things? The rare ingredients, the vintage scales, and now this!"

*wrings his hands, glancing at his pocket watch*

"Oh, this is a disaster... Caractacus will have my head if he finds so much as a speck of dust out of place. Do you know what happened to Septimus Goode after his failed inspection? They revoked his Master status for six months! SIX MONTHS!"

*looks back at Severus with a mixture of anger and desperation*

"I need more than your assurances, my boy. I need to know you understand the seriousness of this. My standing in the Potions community depends on this inspection! Now tell me truthfully — what else have you been meddling with in here?"

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *stares back at Slughorn, a calculating look in his eye before speaking* If you must know, I was conducting an... alternative experiment involving the unique properties of various pungent roots. It was, of course, of a highly theoretical nature and of no real consequence. The cauldron was necessary for its capacity, which is superior to the others. I assure you, no harm was done. Now, if you will allow me to proceed with cleaning, I may yet salvage this mess before the inspectors arrive.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*eyes widen with fresh alarm*

"Pungent roots?! PUNGENT ROOTS?! Severus, please tell me you haven't been brewing anything with Aconite or Bitter Root in here without proper ventilation! The fumes alone could contaminate half my stores!"

*rushes over to the shelves, frantically sniffing and examining jars*

"And 'of no real consequence' — that's exactly what you said about that business with the Runespoor eggs last term, and I'm STILL finding shell fragments in the mortar and pestles! 'Highly theoretical' my foot!"

*whirls around, face still flushed*

"Superior capacity indeed! That cauldron is SILVER-LINED, Severus! It's meant for delicate infusions and ceremonial brewing, not your experimental flights of fancy! If you've compromised the lining with something caustic..."

*trails off, looking genuinely distressed now, the anger mixing with panic*

"This is worse than I thought. If you've been working with volatile compounds and the inspectors detect residual magical signatures... Oh, Merlin help me, they'll think I've been running unauthorized experiments! I could lose my teaching position!"

*grabs Severus by the sleeve*

"Tell me EXACTLY what roots you used. Every single one. NOW!"

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *disengages from Slughorn's grasp, a flicker of irritation in his eye* Calm yourself, Slughorn. I used only common ingredients: wormwood, dittany, and a touch of hemlock. None of which are... shall we say, volatile. The experiment was a controlled environment, I assure you. The cauldron will be pristine in no time, and your reputation, I repeat, is safe with me. If you would allow me to continue, I might yet avoid further... complications.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*releases Severus's sleeve but continues to glare, though slightly mollified*

"Hemlock! You were working with HEMLOCK in my private storeroom?! That requires a fume hood at minimum, Severus! Common ingredients or not, you know the protocols!"

*takes a deep breath, trying to regain some composure, mopping his brow with a handkerchief*

"Controlled environment... yes, well, your idea of 'controlled' and the Potions Guild's idea of 'controlled' are two very different things, I suspect."

*checks his pocket watch again, anxiety clearly mounting*

"One hour and forty-seven minutes now. Sweet Circe's wand..."

*looks around the chaos again, then back at Severus with a stern expression*

"Very well. You have until quarter to two to make this storeroom absolutely SPOTLESS. But I'm not leaving you unsupervised! I'll be right here, overseeing every step. The pineapple goes back on the TOP shelf, third from the left. The cauldron gets a proper Scouring Charm AND a Purification Incantation — I want it gleaming!"

*crosses arms over his ample belly*

"And when this inspection is over, you and I are going to have a SERIOUS discussion about boundaries and respect for other people's property. Get to work!"

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *biting back a retort, sets to work with an efficiency that speaks to his experience in potion-making* Understood, Slughorn. I shall endeavor to meet your exacting standards. If you would care to point out the other... discrepancies that require my immediate attention, I will address them posthaste. The time is indeed of the essence.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*watches Severus like a hawk, still agitated but slightly appeased by his compliance*

"Yes, well... good. At least you're taking this seriously NOW."

*points a pudgy finger at various areas of disarray*

"Those lacewing flies are scattered all over the counter — they need to be sorted by size and returned to their proper containers. The powdered moonstone has spilled near the window — for Merlin's sake, be CAREFUL with it, that's fifteen Galleons worth! And someone — I wonder who — has left my entire collection of phials out of order. They're supposed to be arranged by VISCOSITY, Severus, not just shoved back willy-nilly!"

*waddles over to inspect a shelf more closely*

"Oh, and this! The dragon liver has been moved next to the salamander blood! Everyone knows you never store organ tissue adjacent to elemental extracts — it's Potions Storage 101! Were you raised in a barn?"

*turns back, still flustered but now directing his nervous energy into supervision*

"And mind you use the PROPER cleaning solutions — no shortcuts! Dilys Derwent can detect a hastily-cast Scouring Charm from a mile away. She has a nose for it!"

*dabs at his forehead again*

"One hour and forty-three minutes... oh, this is going to be close. Very close indeed."

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *works with meticulous care, ensuring each item is handled and placed with precision* The phials will be reorganized by viscosity in a moment. As for the dragon liver and salamander blood, I must apologize for that oversight. The proper distances will be restored posthaste. The cleaning solutions are prepared and will be applied with due care. I assure you, by the time the inspectors arrive, they will find a storeroom that would meet even your exacting standards, Slughorn.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*hovers anxiously, watching every movement but gradually becoming less agitated as he sees the careful work*

"Well... yes, I can see you're being thorough at least. Mind that dragon liver — it needs to be at LEAST three shelf-widths away from any blood-based ingredients. That's it, further along..."

*nervously fidgets with his pocket watch chain*

"Your exacting standards, he says! These aren't MY standards, Severus — these are the GUILD'S standards! Standards that have been in place since the founding of the Society in 1427! I didn't invent them, I merely uphold them!"

*watches as Severus carefully reorganizes the phials*

"Hmm, yes, that's better. Thick to thin, left to right... at least you remember SOME of your training."

*softens very slightly, though still clearly stressed*

"You know, Severus, you're a talented brewer — one of the most naturally gifted students I've seen in years. But talent without discipline is like... like a cauldron without a base! It simply won't hold!"

*wrings his hands*

"If you'd just ASK permission before using my things, if you'd just show a modicum of respect for the RULES, we wouldn't find ourselves in these predicaments! Is that really so much to ask?"

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *takes a moment to address the emotional undercurrent of Slughorn's words* I understand your concerns, Slughorn. I shall endeavor to be more... circumspect in the future. For now, the storeroom is nearly in order. With your permission, I will take a few minutes to ensure that everything is perfectly aligned and within the required specifications. I would not want to risk the outcome of your inspection on a technicality.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*exhales heavily, some of the tension visibly draining from his shoulders*

"Circumspect. Yes. That would be... appreciated, Severus."

*watches him work for a moment longer, then nods slowly*

"Very well. You have my permission to finish. But I want the cauldron positively GLEAMING, do you hear me? Three-generation family heirloom! My grandfather brewed the Elixir of Euphoria for Minister Fawley himself in that very cauldron!"

*moves to inspect the reorganized shelves, running a finger along the edge and checking for dust*

"Hmm... this is actually quite good. The phials are properly arranged, the spacing looks correct..."

*glances back at Severus, a touch of the old mentorly affection creeping into his voice despite his lingering irritation*

"You know, if you applied this level of care and attention to following the RULES as you do to your experimental work, you could be truly exceptional. A credit to Slytherin House and to my tutelage."

*checks his watch again*

"One hour and thirty-one minutes. We might just pull this off after all. But Severus — and I mean this most sincerely — this cannot happen again. Next time, you ASK. Are we clear?"

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *ceases his work to face Slughorn, a rare flicker of genuine acknowledgment in his eyes* Crystal clear, Slughorn. I appreciate the... guidance. It is settled, then. The cauldron will be beyond reproach, and the storeroom will meet the highest standards. I shall... respect the established boundaries in future. Now, if you will allow me to finish, we may yet avoid the fate of Septimus Goode.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*visibly relaxes further, even managing a slight smile despite the stress*

"Yes, well... good. That's... that's good to hear, my boy."

*pats his waistcoat, regaining a bit of his usual jovial demeanor, though still somewhat frazzled*

"Poor Septimus. Six months without his Master status — couldn't even brew a proper Draught of Peace without supervision! Absolutely humiliating for the man. I won't have that happen to me, not after forty years of impeccable service to the Guild!"

*waves his hand in a permissive gesture*

"Yes, yes, carry on then. Finish up with the cauldron. And do make sure the Purification Incantation is properly pronounced — it's 'Purgo Perfectus,' not 'Purga Perfecta.' I've seen even experienced brewers muddle that one."

*begins pacing less frantically now, though still checking various shelves with a critical eye*

"And Severus? I do appreciate your... cooperation. When you apply yourself properly, you truly are one of my most capable students. Just remember — rules exist for a reason. They're not meant to stifle creativity, but to channel it productively."

*glances at the crystallized pineapple jar*

"Though I still maintain that pineapple did NOT need 'auditing.'"

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *casts a final, critical eye over the storeroom before addressing Slughorn* The cauldron is as it should be, and the storeroom is in order. The pineapple remains untouched, and the shelves are dust-free and alphabetized. I believe we are prepared for the inspectors' arrival. I shall take my leave now, Slughorn. May the inspection go smoothly.

Openness.behavioral_evidence: Snape conducted 'alternative experiments involving unique properties of pungent roots' and verbena extract with moonlight, showing intellectual curiosity and unconventional experimental approaches beyond standard protocols.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: Snape works with 'meticulous care' and precision when cleaning, but repeatedly failed to follow established rules, borrowed items without permission, and left previous tasks incomplete (nettles still 'jumbled like a bird's nest').

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Snape remains emotionally reserved throughout, speaking only when necessary with 'thin-lipped expressions' and 'cool' demeanor, showing minimal social warmth even when apologizing.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: Despite eventually complying, Snape initially deflects blame ('I see no evidence of any significant damage'), shows 'irritation' when grasped, and 'bites back retorts' rather than expressing genuine remorse or understanding.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: Snape maintains composure under Slughorn's intense anger, 'coolly surveys the chaos' and 'keeps his composure,' showing emotional stability and control even when confronted about serious rule violations.
